text:
Two chaotic worlds. One dragon boy. One tiger beast.
And a battle insane enough to destroy an entire planet.

Just finished creating this fun cinematic battle universe using GPT Image 2 + Seedance 2.0 on @yapper_so 

Everything from the character sheets, skill effects, weapons, logos, storyboard panels, to the final “Meteor Dragon” apocalypse sequence was generated with AI.
Honestly crazy how far visual storytelling is evolving right now.

This feels like making an animated movie straight from imagination. 

Made with:
• GPT Image 2
• Seedance 2.0
• @yapper_so 
• Capcut

Prompt breakdown in the thread below.

#AIAnimation #GPTImage2 #Seedance #Seedance2 #Yapper #3DArt #Anime #AIFilm #Storyboard #AIArt #Animation #GameArt #Cinematic #Dragon #Tiger #CreativeAI

PROMPT 1 — CHAOS OPENING
Cinematic handheld camera flying through dusty canyon arena, Draco and Tigerro staring each other down while wind blows banners violently. Sudden sonic boom as both dash forward at impossible speed, camera shaking from impacts. Tigerro slides under explosions then unleashes lightning claw combo, orange thunder tearing through rocks. Dynamic closeups, fast tracking shots, dramatic slow motion impacts. Draco summons giant lava dragon erupting from ground roaring into sky. Tigerro wall-runs across canyon cliffs then dives down with thunder tiger kick smashing dragon head apart. Debris and fire flood the screen. Draco creates 100 shadow clones charging together. Tigerro laughs and summons gigantic spectral tiger spirit behind him, roaring shockwave blasting clones away. Both fighters crash fists together center arena creating huge explosion vortex sucking dust and rocks upward. Sound effects only: dragon roars, thunder cracks, explosions, claws scraping stone, battle screams, fire bursts, rubble collapse, no music.

PROMPT 2 — MONSTER MAYHEM
Fast cinematic camera circling chaotic battlefield at sunset, canyon burning from previous attacks. Draco launches into air with flaming dragon wings while Tigerro leaps cliff to cliff surrounded by electric tigers. Draco slams both hands down summoning giant cactus dragon monster with glowing magma veins. Tigerro responds by summoning armored thunder tiger army sprinting through dust clouds. Massive creature war erupts everywhere. Camera whip pans between explosive impacts and close combat. Draco fires giant fire beam across arena melting rocks instantly. Tigerro counters with lightning dash creating dozens of afterimages slicing through beam. Huge comic-style impact frames mixed with cinematic realism. Draco rides giant dragon tornado through canyon while Tigerro surfs on electric tiger spirit crashing through explosions. Rocks rain from sky, canyon walls collapse, banners ignite. Final sequence both summon colossal elemental beasts behind them, magma dragon versus storm tiger, camera spinning upward as monsters collide in gigantic explosion wave covering entire battlefield. Sound effects only: monster roars, lightning strikes, magma eruptions, crashing rocks, rapid punches, energy blasts, heavy breathing, no background music.

PROMPT 3 — NIGHTMARE MODE
Epic cinematic night battle under giant moon, camera moving aggressively through smoke and blue fire. Draco enters dark dragon mode, green flames leaking from hoodie spikes. Tigerro activates savage predator form with glowing orange eyes and electric claws. Both disappear instantly then reappear clashing midair repeatedly at blinding speed. Shockwaves split clouds above canyon. Draco summons skeletal ghost dragon flying across battlefield breathing cursed flames. Tigerro dodges using lightning teleport movement then launches spinning tiger barrage combo through dragon skull. Camera rotates wildly around combat, cinematic motion blur, dramatic closeups of angry expressions. Draco traps Tigerro inside giant dragon mouth portal full of fire tornadoes. Tigerro roars and summons cosmic thunder tiger bursting through portal in massive explosion. Flaming debris rains everywhere. Draco creates giant spike pillars chasing Tigerro across battlefield while Tigerro parkours across collapsing rocks delivering aerial kicks. Final clash sequence: both scream while charging ultimate attacks, giant fire dragon beam collides with colossal lightning tiger cannon, entire canyon explodes into white light. Sound effects only: ghost screams, thunder booms, dragon fire, explosion echoes, rapid impacts, roaring wind, intense battle shouts, no music.

PROMPT 4 — FINAL GOD BATTLE
Ultra cinematic sunrise battle, camera sweeping across destroyed canyon covered in smoke, lava cracks, broken skull monuments. Draco and Tigerro stand exhausted before charging one final time. Extreme speed combat with insane anime choreography, camera constantly orbiting, shaking, zooming through explosions. Draco summons endless colorful mini dragons flooding battlefield like tidal wave. Tigerro counters by summoning giant celestial tiger armor around body. Every punch creates shockwaves tearing apart canyon cliffs. Draco creates giant elemental wheel of dragon spirits spinning behind him while Tigerro unleashes thunder storm from sky. Lightning strikes everywhere, fire tornadoes twisting upward, floating rocks surrounding battlefield. Draco rides massive magma dragon through explosion clouds. Tigerro launches through sky riding gigantic thunder tiger crashing headfirst into dragon. Both monsters explode into fiery storm. Final ultimate combo: Draco uses Thousand Dragon Catastrophe while Tigerro activates Heaven Tiger Judgment, giant dragon and tiger avatars fighting across sky like gods. Camera flies through explosions and energy beams before both heroes collide fists in final slow motion impact, giant shockwave blasting clouds apart revealing sunrise. Ending with both collapsing laughing while tiny dragons and baby tigers run around destroyed battlefield. Sound effects only: colossal explosions, dragon and tiger roars, thunder storms, fire blasts, rubble destruction, exhausted laughter, energy surges, no background music.

Additional Prompt:

PROMPT 2.1 — DRAGON RAMPAGE
Cinematic battle continuation at burning sunset canyon, smoke and embers filling the sky. Camera rushes low across cracked ground toward Draco standing atop giant dragon skull. Tigerro suddenly appears behind him with lightning claw strike, massive impact shockwave exploding rocks outward. Draco flips backward laughing then summons enormous magma dragon serpent spiraling around battlefield. Dynamic camera follows serpent crashing through canyon towers while Tigerro parkours across falling debris. Draco launches rapid-fire flaming dragon missiles shaped like cute baby dragons. Tigerro counters using thunder spin kick creating electric tornado swallowing missiles midair. Explosive closeups, intense motion blur, anime-style impact frames mixed with cinematic realism. Draco slams ground creating giant lava fissures chasing Tigerro. Tigerro leaps through explosions summoning spectral tiger clones attacking from every direction. Massive combo exchange across collapsing canyon bridge. Final moment: Draco fuses with magma dragon becoming giant armored dragon beast while Tigerro charges glowing thunder claws preparing counterattack. Sound effects only: magma eruptions, dragon screams, thunder cracks, collapsing rocks, claw slashes, battle yells, no music.

PROMPT 2.2 — THUNDER TIGER CHAOS
Epic cinematic camera spinning around nighttime canyon battlefield illuminated by orange lightning and blue fire. Tigerro enters ultimate predator mode, giant thunder tiger aura roaring behind him. Draco flies overhead using blazing dragon wings leaving trails of fire through clouds. Tigerro punches ground creating giant electric shockwave splitting arena apart. Draco counters by summoning floating stone dragons orbiting battlefield firing lasers everywhere. Camera aggressively whip-pans between attacks and destruction. Tigerro dashes across vertical canyon walls at insane speed creating afterimages. Draco traps him inside spinning dragon cyclone full of fireballs and spikes. Tigerro roars loudly then explodes outward in massive lightning burst vaporizing cyclone instantly. Huge debris rains from sky while spectral tiger army clashes against skeletal dragon monsters in background. Draco and Tigerro exchange aerial punches above canyon before crashing downward like meteors causing giant explosion crater. Final sequence: Tigerro summons colossal thunder tiger from storm clouds biting toward Draco while Draco opens gigantic dragon portal swallowing lightning attack whole. Sound effects only: electric storms, roaring monsters, fire explosions, giant impacts, cracking stone, fast footsteps, battle cries, no background music.

PROMPT 2.3 — APOCALYPSE CLASH
Ultra cinematic final extension battle during stormy sunrise, battlefield completely destroyed with floating rocks, lava rivers, shattered skull monuments. Camera flies through smoke toward Draco and Tigerro charging simultaneously. Both move faster than before, creating constant shockwaves with every collision. Draco summons endless army of tiny colorful dragons flooding canyon like living firestorm. Tigerro answers by summoning giant celestial tiger warriors descending from clouds. Massive war erupts across battlefield. Dynamic aerial shots, close combat tracking, dramatic slow motion explosions. Draco creates giant dragon tornado lifting entire canyon debris into sky. Tigerro launches upward wrapped in lightning spiral piercing tornado center. Huge elemental collision turns sky orange and blue. Draco unleashes ultimate attack, Thousand Dragon Meteor Barrage, giant flaming dragons raining from heavens. Tigerro activates Heaven Beast Cataclysm, colossal lightning tiger smashing meteors apart midair. Explosions cover entire screen. Final cinematic clash: giant dragon avatar and giant tiger avatar battle above canyon while Draco and Tigerro exchange punches below at blinding speed. Massive final explosion clears smoke revealing both exhausted heroes standing together while tiny dragons and baby tigers play around destroyed arena. Sound effects only: colossal explosions, thunder storms, dragon roars, tiger growls, flying debris, lava eruptions, exhausted laughter, no music.

Cámara cinematográfica en mano volando a través de una polvorienta arena de cañón, Draco y Tigerro se miran fijamente mientras el viento agita violentamente las banderas. Un súbito boom sónico cuando ambos se lanzan hacia adelante a una velocidad imposible, la cámara tiembla por los impactos. Draco gira en el aire invocando docenas de pequeños dragones de fuego que giran alrededor del campo de batalla escupiendo llamas por todas partes. Tigerro se desliza bajo las explosiones y luego desata un combo de garras eléctricas, un trueno naranja desgarrando las rocas. Primeros planos dinámicos, tomas de seguimiento rápidas, impactos en cámara lenta dramáticos. Draco invoca un dragón de lava gigante que emerge del suelo rugiendo hacia el cielo. Tigerro corre por las paredes de los acantilados del cañón y luego se lanza con una patada de tigre de trueno destrozando la cabeza del dragón. Escombros y fuego inundan la pantalla. Draco crea 100 clones de sombra cargando juntos. Tigerro ríe e invoca un gigantesco espíritu de tigre espectral detrás de él, una onda de choque rugiente que aleja a los clones. Ambos luchadores chocan los puños en el centro de la arena creando un enorme vórtice de explosión que succiona polvo y rocas hacia arriba. Solo efectos de sonido: rugidos de dragón, crujidos de trueno, explosiones, garras raspando piedra, gritos de batalla, estallidos de fuego, colapso de escombros, sin música.

Caméra cinématographique à main levée volant à travers une arène de canyon poussiéreux, Draco et Tigerro se fixant intensément tandis que le vent souffle violemment les bannières. Un boom sonique soudain alors que les deux se précipitent à une vitesse impossible, la caméra tremble sous les impacts. Draco tourne en l'air, invoquant des dizaines de petits dragons de feu spirale autour du champ de bataille, crachant des flammes partout. Tigerro glisse sous les explosions puis déclenche une combinaison de griffes éclair, le tonnerre orange déchirant les rochers. Gros plans dynamiques, plans de suivi rapides, impacts dramatiques au ralenti. Draco invoque un gigantesque dragon de lave émergeant du sol, rugissant vers le ciel. Tigerro court sur les parois des falaises du canyon puis plonge avec un coup de pied de tigre tonnerre fracassant la tête du dragon. Débris et feu inondent l'écran. Draco crée 100 clones d'ombre chargeant ensemble. Tigerro rit et invoque un gigantesque esprit de tigre spectral derrière lui, une onde de choc rugissante dispersant les clones. Les deux combattants s'écrasent les poings ensemble au centre de l'arène, créant un énorme vortex d'explosion aspirant poussière et rochers vers le haut. Effets sonores uniquement : rugissements de dragon, craquements de tonnerre, explosions, griffes raclant la pierre, cris de bataille, éclats de feu, effondrement de débris, pas de musique.

PROMPT 2 — MONSTER MAYHEM
Caméra cinématographique rapide tournant autour d'un champ de bataille chaotique au coucher du soleil, le canyon brûlant des attaques précédentes. Draco s'élance dans les airs avec des ailes de dragon enflammées tandis que Tigerro saute de falaise en falaise entouré de tigres électriques. Draco frappe des deux mains pour invoquer un gigantesque monstre dragon cactus avec des veines de magma lumineuses. Tigerro répond en invoquant une armée de tigres tonnerre blindés courant à travers les nuages de poussière. Une guerre massive de créatures éclate partout. La caméra effectue des panoramiques rapides entre les impacts explosifs et le combat rapproché. Draco tire un gigantesque rayon de feu à travers l'arène, faisant fondre les rochers instantanément. Tigerro contre avec une ruée éclair créant des dizaines d'images rémanentes tranchant à travers le rayon. Immenses cadres d'impact style bande dessinée mélangés avec un réalisme cinématographique. Draco chevauche une tornade de dragon géante à travers le canyon tandis que Tigerro surfe sur un esprit de tigre électrique traversant les explosions. Les rochers pleuvent du ciel, les parois du canyon s'effondrent, les bannières s'enflamment. Séquence finale où les deux invoquent des bêtes élémentaires colossales derrière eux, dragon de magma contre tigre de tempête, la caméra tournant vers le haut alors que les monstres se heurtent dans une vague d'explosion gigantesque couvrant tout le champ de bataille. Effets sonores uniquement : rugissements de monstres, éclairs, éruptions de magma, rochers qui s'écrasent, coups rapides, rafales d'énergie, respiration lourde, pas de musique de fond.

PROMPT 3 — NIGHTMARE MODE
Bataille nocturne épique cinématographique sous une lune géante, la caméra se déplaçant agressivement à travers la fumée et le feu bleu. Draco entre en mode dragon sombre, des flammes vertes s'échappant des pointes de son sweat à capuche. Tigerro active la forme de prédateur sauvage avec des yeux orange lumineux et des griffes électriques. Les deux disparaissent instantanément puis réapparaissent en s'affrontant en l'air à une vitesse aveuglante. Les ondes de choc fendent les nuages au-dessus du canyon. Draco invoque un dragon fantôme squelettique volant à travers le champ de bataille, crachant des flammes maudites. Tigerro esquive en utilisant un mouvement de téléportation éclair puis lance une combinaison de barrage de tigres tournoyants à travers le crâne du dragon. La caméra tourne sauvagement autour du combat, flou cinématographique, gros plans dramatiques des expressions en colère. Draco piège Tigerro à l'intérieur d'une bouche de dragon géante pleine de tornades de feu. Tigerro rugit et invoque un tigre cosmique tonnerre éclatant à travers le portail dans une explosion massive. Des débris enflammés pleuvent partout. Draco crée d'énormes piliers de pointes poursuivant Tigerro à travers le champ de bataille tandis que Tigerro fait du parkour à travers les rochers qui s'effondrent en délivrant des coups de pied aériens. Séquence finale de choc : les deux crient en chargeant leurs attaques ultimes, un gigantesque rayon de dragon de feu entre en collision avec un canon colossal de tigre de foudre, tout le canyon explose en une lumière blanche. Effets sonores uniquement : cris de fantômes, grondements de tonnerre, feu de dragon, échos d'explosions, impacts rapides, vent rugissant, cris de bataille intenses, pas de musique.

PROMPT 4 — FINAL GOD BATTLE
Bataille à l'aube ultra cinématographique, la caméra balayant le canyon détruit couvert de fumée, de fissures de lave, de monuments de crânes brisés. Draco et Tigerro se tiennent épuisés avant de charger une dernière fois. Combat à vitesse extrême avec une chorégraphie d'anime insensée, la caméra orbitant constamment, tremblant, zoomant à travers les explosions. Draco invoque d'innombrables mini-dragons colorés inondant le champ de bataille comme une vague déferlante. Tigerro contre en invoquant une armure de tigre céleste géante autour de son corps. Chaque coup de poing crée des ondes de choc déchirant les falaises du canyon. Draco crée une roue géante d'esprits de dragons élémentaires tournant derrière lui tandis que Tigerro déchaîne une tempête de tonnerre depuis le ciel. Les éclairs frappent partout, les tornades de feu tourbillonnent vers le haut, des rochers flottants entourent le champ de bataille. Draco chevauche un immense dragon de magma à travers les nuages d'explosion. Tigerro se lance à travers le ciel chevauchant un gigantesque tigre de tonnerre s'écrasant tête la première dans le dragon. Les deux monstres explosent dans une tempête de feu. Combo ultime final : Draco utilise la Catastrophe des Mille Dragons tandis que Tigerro active le Jugement du Tigre Céleste, des avatars géants de dragon et de tigre se battant dans le ciel comme des dieux. La caméra vole à travers les explosions et les faisceaux d'énergie avant que les deux héros ne se heurtent les poings dans un impact final au ralenti, une onde de choc géante dispersant les nuages révélant le lever du soleil. Finissant avec les deux s'effondrant en riant tandis que de petits dragons et bébés tigres courent autour du champ de bataille détruit. シネマティックなハンドヘルドカメラが埃っぽい峡谷のアリーナを飛び回り、ドラコとタイガーロが互いに睨み合う中、風が激しく旗を揺らす。突然のソニックブームで両者が不可能な速度で前進し、衝撃でカメラが揺れる。ドラコは空中で回転しながら、戦場を螺旋状に取り囲む小さな火のドラゴンを多数召喚し、至る所に炎を吐く。タイガーロは爆発の下を滑り抜け、雷の爪コンボを放ち、オレンジ色の雷が岩を引き裂く。ダイナミックなクローズアップ、速いトラッキングショット、ドラマチックなスローモーションの衝撃。ドラコは地面から噴き出す巨大な溶岩ドラゴンを召喚し、空に向かって咆哮する。タイガーロは峡谷の崖を壁走りし、雷の虎キックでドラゴンの頭を粉砕しながら飛び込む。画面は瓦礫と炎で溢れる。ドラコは100体の影分身を作り、一斉に突撃する。タイガーロは笑い、背後に巨大なスペクトラルタイガースピリットを召喚し、咆哮の衝撃波で分身を吹き飛ばす。両者はアリーナの中央で拳をぶつけ合い、巨大な爆発の渦が埃と岩を上方に吸い上げる。音響効果のみ：ドラゴンの咆哮、雷鳴、爆発、石を削る爪、戦闘の叫び声、炎の爆発、瓦礫の崩壊、音楽なし。

PROMPT 1 — CHAOS OPENING
Cinematic handheld camera flying through dusty canyon arena, Draco and Tigerro staring each other down while wind blows banners violently. Sudden sonic boom as both dash forward at impossible speed, camera shaking from impacts. Draco spins midair summoning dozens of tiny fire dragons spiraling around battlefield breathing flames everywhere. Tigerro slides under explosions then unleashes lightning claw combo, orange thunder tearing through rocks. Dynamic closeups, fast tracking shots, dramatic slow motion impacts. Draco summons giant lava dragon erupting from ground roaring into sky. Tigerro wall-runs across canyon cliffs then dives down with thunder tiger kick smashing dragon head apart. Debris and fire flood the screen. Draco creates 100 shadow clones charging together. Tigerro laughs and summons gigantic spectral tiger spirit behind him, roaring shockwave blasting clones away. Both fighters crash fists together center arena creating huge explosion vortex sucking dust and rocks upward. Sound effects only: dragon roars, thunder cracks, explosions, claws scraping stone, battle screams, fire bursts, rubble collapse, no music.

PROMPT 2 — MONSTER MAYHEM
Fast cinematic camera circling chaotic battlefield at sunset, canyon burning from previous attacks. Draco launches into air with flaming dragon wings while Tigerro leaps cliff to cliff surrounded by electric tigers. Draco slams both hands down summoning giant cactus dragon monster with glowing magma veins. Tigerro responds by summoning armored thunder tiger army sprinting through dust clouds. Massive creature war erupts everywhere. Camera whip pans between explosive impacts and close combat. Draco fires giant fire beam across arena melting rocks instantly. Tigerro counters with lightning dash creating dozens of afterimages slicing through beam. Huge comic-style impact frames mixed with cinematic realism. Draco rides giant dragon tornado through canyon while Tigerro surfs on electric tiger spirit crashing through explosions. Rocks rain from sky, canyon walls collapse, banners ignite. Final sequence both summon colossal elemental beasts behind them, magma dragon versus storm tiger, camera spinning upward as monsters collide in gigantic explosion wave covering entire battlefield. Sound effects only: monster roars, lightning strikes, magma eruptions, crashing rocks, rapid punches, energy blasts, heavy breathing, no background music.

PROMPT 3 — NIGHTMARE MODE
Epic cinematic night battle under giant moon, camera moving aggressively through smoke and blue fire. Draco enters dark dragon mode, green flames leaking from hoodie spikes. Tigerro activates savage predator form with glowing orange eyes and electric claws. Both disappear instantly then reappear clashing midair repeatedly at blinding speed. Shockwaves split clouds above canyon. Draco summons skeletal ghost dragon flying across battlefield breathing cursed flames. Tigerro dodges using lightning teleport movement then launches spinning tiger barrage combo through dragon skull. Camera rotates wildly around combat, cinematic motion blur, dramatic closeups of angry expressions. Draco traps Tigerro inside giant dragon mouth portal full of fire tornadoes. Tigerro roars and summons cosmic thunder tiger bursting through portal in massive explosion. Flaming debris rains everywhere. Draco creates giant spike pillars chasing Tigerro across battlefield while Tigerro parkours across collapsing rocks delivering aerial kicks. Final clash sequence: both scream while charging ultimate attacks, giant fire dragon beam collides with colossal lightning tiger cannon, entire canyon explodes into white light. Sound effects only: ghost screams, thunder booms, dragon fire, explosion echoes, rapid impacts, roaring wind, intense battle shouts, no music.

PROMPT 4 — FINAL GOD BATTLE
Ultra cinematic sunrise battle, camera sweeping across destroyed canyon covered in smoke, lava cracks, broken skull monuments. Draco and Tigerro stand exhausted before charging one final time. Extreme speed combat with insane anime choreography, camera constantly orbiting, shaking, zooming through explosions. Draco summons endless colorful mini dragons flooding battlefield like tidal wave. Tigerro counters by summoning giant celestial tiger armor around body. Every punch creates shockwaves tearing apart canyon cliffs. Draco creates giant elemental wheel of dragon spirits spinning behind him while Tigerro unleashes thunder storm from sky. Lightning strikes everywhere, fire tornadoes twisting upward, floating rocks surrounding battlefield. Draco rides massive magma dragon through explosion clouds. Tigerro launches through sky riding gigantic thunder tiger crashing headfirst into dragon. Both monsters explode into fiery storm. Final ultimate combo: Draco uses Thousand Dragon Catastrophe while Tigerro activates Heaven Tiger Judgment, giant dragon and tiger avatars fighting across sky like gods. Camera flies through explosions and energy beams before both heroes collide fists in final slow motion impact, giant shockwave blasting clouds apart revealing sunrise. Ending with both collapsing laughing while tiny dragons and baby tigers run around destroyed battlefield. Sound effects only: colossal explosions, dragon and tiger roars, thunder storms, fire blasts, rubble destruction, exhausted laughter, energy surges, no background music.

translations.ko:
---
시네마틱 핸드헬드 카메라가 먼지 낀 협곡 경기장을 날아다니며, Draco와 Tigerro가 서로를 응시하고 있는 가운데 바람이 깃발을 거세게 흔듭니다. 두 사람이 불가능한 속도로 앞으로 돌진하면서 갑작스러운 소닉 붐이 발생하고, 충격으로 카메라가 흔들립니다. Draco는 공중에서 회전하며 수십 마리의 작은 불꽃 용을 소환하여 전장을 나선형으로 돌며 불을 뿜습니다. Tigerro는 폭발 아래로 미끄러져 번개 발톱 콤보를 발사하여 주황색 번개가 바위를 찢습니다. 역동적인 클로즈업, 빠른 추적 샷, 극적인 슬로우 모션 충돌. Draco는 땅에서 솟아오르는 거대한 용암 용을 소환하여 하늘로 포효합니다. Tigerro는 협곡 절벽을 따라 벽을 달리다가 번개 호랑이 킥으로 용의 머리를 부수며 뛰어내립니다. 파편과 불길이 화면을 가득 채웁니다. Draco는 100개의 그림자 클론을 만들어 함께 돌진합니다. Tigerro는 웃으며 거대한 스펙트럴 타이거 스피릿을 소환하여 포효하는 충격파로 클론을 날려버립니다. 두 전사는 경기장 중앙에서 주먹을 부딪쳐 거대한 폭발 소용돌이를 만들어 먼지와 바위를 위로 빨아들입니다. 소리 효과만: 용의 포효, 천둥 소리, 폭발, 발톱이 돌을 긁는 소리, 전투의 비명, 불꽃 폭발, 파편 붕괴, 음악 없음.

translations.pt-BR:
---
Câmera cinematográfica de mão voando através de uma arena de cânion empoeirada, Draco e Tigerro se encarando enquanto o vento sopra violentamente as bandeiras. Um estrondo sônico repentino quando ambos avançam a uma velocidade impossível, a câmera tremendo com os impactos. Draco gira no ar, invocando dezenas de pequenos dragões de fogo que espiralam ao redor do campo de batalha, cuspindo chamas por toda parte. Tigerro desliza sob as explosões e então libera um combo de garras elétricas, trovão laranja rasgando as rochas. Close-ups dinâmicos, tomadas de rastreamento rápido, impactos dramáticos em câmera lenta. Draco invoca um dragão de lava gigante que irrompe do chão rugindo para o céu. Tigerro corre pelas paredes do cânion e depois mergulha com um chute de tigre trovão, destruindo a cabeça do dragão. Detritos e fogo inundam a tela. Draco cria 100 clones de sombra avançando juntos. Tigerro ri e invoca um espírito de tigre espectral gigantesco atrás dele, uma onda de choque rugindo afastando os clones. Ambos os lutadores colidem os punhos no centro da arena, criando um enorme vórtice de explosão sugando poeira e pedras para cima. Apenas efeitos sonoros: rugidos de dragão, rachaduras de trovão, explosões, garras raspando pedra, gritos de batalha, explosões de fogo, colapso de escombros, sem música.

电影感的手持摄像机飞过尘土飞扬的峡谷竞技场，Draco和Tigerro互相凝视，狂风猛烈地吹动旗帜。突然的音爆声中，两人以不可思议的速度向前冲刺，摄像机因冲击而震动。Draco在空中旋转，召唤出数十只小火龙，盘旋在战场上喷吐火焰。Tigerro在爆炸下滑行，然后释放出闪电爪连击，橙色雷电撕裂岩石。动态特写镜头、快速跟踪镜头、戏剧性的慢动作冲击。Draco召唤出巨大的熔岩龙，从地面喷发而出，咆哮着冲向天空。Tigerro沿着峡谷悬崖奔跑，然后俯冲下来，用雷虎踢击碎龙头。碎片和火焰充满屏幕。Draco创造出100个影分身一起冲锋。Tigerro大笑，召唤出巨大的幽灵虎灵在他身后，咆哮的冲击波将分身击飞。两名战士在竞技场中央拳头相撞，产生巨大的爆炸漩涡，吸起尘土和岩石。只有音效：龙的咆哮、雷声、爆炸声、爪子刮擦石头声、战斗尖叫声、火焰爆发声、瓦砾坍塌声，无音乐。

[线程 3] 提示：

PROMPT 1 — CHAOS OPENING
Cinematic handheld camera flying through dusty canyon arena, Draco and Tigerro staring each other down while wind blows banners violently. Sudden sonic boom as both dash forward at impossible speed, camera shaking from impacts. Draco spins midair summoning dozens of tiny fire dragons spiraling around battlefield breathing flames everywhere. Tigerro slides under explosions then unleashes lightning claw combo, orange thunder tearing through rocks. Dynamic closeups, fast tracking shots, dramatic slow motion impacts. Draco summons giant lava dragon erupting from ground roaring into sky. Tigerro wall-runs across canyon cliffs then dives down with thunder tiger kick smashing dragon head apart. Debris and fire flood the screen. Draco creates 100 shadow clones charging together. Tigerro laughs and summons gigantic spectral tiger spirit behind him, roaring shockwave blasting clones away. Both fighters crash fists together center arena creating huge explosion vortex sucking dust and rocks upward. Sound effects only: dragon roars, thunder cracks, explosions, claws scraping stone, battle screams, fire bursts, rubble collapse, no music.

PROMPT 2 — MONSTER MAYHEM
Fast cinematic camera circling chaotic battlefield at sunset, canyon burning from previous attacks. Draco launches into air with flaming dragon wings while Tigerro leaps cliff to cliff surrounded by electric tigers. Draco slams both hands down summoning giant cactus dragon monster with glowing magma veins. Tigerro responds by summoning armored thunder tiger army sprinting through dust clouds. Massive creature war erupts everywhere. Camera whip pans between explosive impacts and close combat. Draco fires giant fire beam across arena melting rocks instantly. Tigerro counters with lightning dash creating dozens of afterimages slicing through beam. Huge comic-style impact frames mixed with cinematic realism. Draco rides giant dragon tornado through canyon while Tigerro surfs on electric tiger spirit crashing through explosions. Rocks rain from sky, canyon walls collapse, banners ignite. Final sequence both summon colossal elemental beasts behind them, magma dragon versus storm tiger, camera spinning upward as monsters collide in gigantic explosion wave covering entire battlefield. Sound effects only: monster roars, lightning strikes, magma eruptions, crashing rocks, rapid punches, energy blasts, heavy breathing, no background music.

PROMPT 3 — NIGHTMARE MODE
Epic cinematic night battle under giant moon, camera moving aggressively through smoke and blue fire. Draco enters dark dragon mode, green flames leaking from hoodie spikes. Tigerro activates savage predator form with glowing orange eyes and electric claws. Both disappear instantly then reappear clashing midair repeatedly at blinding speed. Shockwaves split clouds above canyon. Draco summons skeletal ghost dragon flying across battlefield breathing cursed flames. Tigerro dodges using lightning teleport movement then launches spinning tiger barrage combo through dragon skull. Camera rotates wildly around combat, cinematic motion blur, dramatic closeups of angry expressions. Draco traps Tigerro inside giant dragon mouth portal full of fire tornadoes. Tigerro roars and summons cosmic thunder tiger bursting through portal in massive explosion. Flaming debris rains everywhere. Draco creates giant spike pillars chasing Tigerro across battlefield while Tigerro parkours across collapsing rocks delivering aerial kicks. Final clash sequence: both scream while charging ultimate attacks, giant fire dragon beam collides with colossal lightning tiger cannon, entire canyon explodes into white light. Sound effects only: ghost screams, thunder booms, dragon fire, explosion echoes, rapid impacts, roaring wind, intense battle shouts, no music.

PROMPT 4 — FINAL GOD BATTLE
Ultra cinematic sunrise battle, camera sweeping across destroyed canyon covered in smoke, lava cracks, broken skull monuments. Draco and Tigerro stand exhausted before charging one final time. Extreme speed combat with insane anime choreography, camera constantly orbiting, shaking, zooming through explosions. Draco summons endless colorful mini dragons flooding battlefield like tidal wave. Tigerro counters by summoning giant celestial tiger armor around body. Every punch creates shockwaves tearing apart canyon cliffs. Draco creates giant elemental wheel of dragon spirits spinning behind him while Tigerro unleashes thunder storm from sky. Lightning strikes everywhere, fire tornadoes twisting upward, floating rocks surrounding battlefield. Draco rides massive magma dragon through explosion clouds. Tigerro launches through sky riding gigantic thunder tiger crashing headfirst into dragon. Both monsters explode into fiery storm. Final ultimate combo: Draco uses Thousand Dragon Catastrophe while Tigerro activates Heaven Tiger Judgment, giant dragon and tiger avatars fighting across sky like gods. Camera flies through explosions and energy beams before both heroes collide fists in final slow motion impact, giant shockwave blasting clouds apart revealing sunrise. Ending with both collapsing laughing while tiny dragons and baby tigers run around destroyed battlefield. Sound effects only: colossal explosions, dragon and tiger roars, thunder storms, fire blasts, rubble destruction, exhausted laughter, energy surges, no background music.

[线程 4] 额外提示：

PROMPT 2.1 — DRAGON RAMPAGE
Cinematic battle continuation at burning sunset canyon, smoke and embers filling the sky. Camera rushes low across cracked ground toward Draco standing atop giant dragon skull. Tigerro suddenly appears behind him with lightning claw strike, massive impact shockwave exploding rocks outward. Draco flips backward laughing then summons enormous magma dragon serpent spiraling around battlefield. Dynamic camera follows serpent crashing through canyon towers while Tigerro parkours across falling debris. Draco launches rapid-fire flaming dragon missiles shaped like cute baby dragons. Tigerro counters using thunder spin kick creating electric tornado swallowing missiles midair. Explosive closeups, intense motion blur, anime-style impact frames mixed with cinematic realism. Draco slams ground creating giant lava fissures chasing Tigerro. Tigerro leaps through explosions summoning spectral tiger clones attacking from every direction. Massive combo exchange across collapsing canyon bridge. Final moment: Draco fuses with magma dragon becoming giant armored dragon beast while Tigerro charges glowing thunder claws preparing counterattack. Sound effects only: magma eruptions, dragon screams, thunder cracks, collapsing rocks, claw slashes, battle yells, no music.

PROMPT 2.2 — THUNDER TIGER CHAOS
Epic cinematic camera spinning around nighttime canyon battlefield illuminated by orange lightning and blue fire. Tigerro enters ultimate predator mode, giant thunder tiger aura roaring behind him. Draco flies overhead using blazing dragon wings leaving trails of fire through clouds. Tigerro punches ground creating giant electric shockwave splitting arena apart. Draco counters by summoning floating stone dragons orbiting battlefield firing lasers everywhere. Camera aggressively whip-pans between attacks and destruction. Tigerro dashes across vertical canyon walls at insane speed creating afterimages. Draco traps him inside spinning dragon cyclone full of fireballs and spikes. Tigerro roars loudly then explodes outward in massive lightning burst vaporizing cyclone instantly. Huge debris rains from sky while spectral tiger army clashes against skeletal dragon monsters in background. Draco and Tigerro exchange aerial punches above canyon before crashing downward like meteors causing giant explosion crater. Final sequence: Tigerro summons colossal thunder tiger from storm clouds biting toward Draco while Draco opens gigantic dragon portal swallowing lightning attack whole. Sound effects only: electric storms, roaring monsters, fire explosions, giant impacts, cracking stone, fast footsteps, battle cries, no background music.

PROMPT 2.3 — APOCALYPSE CLASH
Ultra cinematic final extension battle during stormy sunrise, battlefield completely destroyed with floating rocks, lava rivers, shattered skull monuments. Camera flies through smoke toward Draco and Tigerro charging simultaneously. Both move faster than before, creating constant shockwaves with every collision. Draco summons endless army of tiny colorful dragons flooding canyon like living firestorm. Tigerro answers by summoning giant celestial tiger warriors descending from clouds. Massive war erupts across battlefield. Dynamic aerial shots, close combat tracking, dramatic slow motion explosions. Draco creates giant dragon tornado lifting entire canyon debris into sky. Tigerro launches upward wrapped in lightning spiral piercing tornado center. Huge elemental collision turns sky orange and blue. Draco unleashes ultimate attack, Thousand Dragon Meteor Barrage, giant flaming dragons raining from heavens
